notes: Snapshot values were transcribed from the two linked National Land Authority Rwanda Land Dashboard pages as displayed in a research capture on 2026-10-17. The dashboard pages do not expose the exact underlying reporting period in the captured tables. snapshotDate is the capture date, NOT the date of the underlying deals. These are published aggregates, not individual parcel or apartment transactions, and must not be blended into verified deal-level metrics.

sources.title: Rwanda Land Dashboard — Average Land Price per District
sources.publisher: National Land Authority, Republic of Rwanda
sources.purpose: Published district-level aggregate land-price indicators. Not individual property sale records or apartment/house comparables.
sources.sourcePeriodLabel: Underlying reporting period not stated on the source page.
sources.methodologyNote: Values are transcribed from the dashboard's 'Average Land Price per District' table (RWF/m²). The source table does not disclose a precise period or enough methodology to infer like-for-like house/apartment values.

sources.title: Rwanda Land Dashboard — Average Land Price by Existing Land Use
sources.publisher: National Land Authority, Republic of Rwanda
sources.purpose: Published aggregate price per square metre by existing land-use category, marked by the dashboard as transaction data.
sources.sourcePeriodLabel: Underlying reporting period not stated on the source page.
sources.methodologyNote: Values are transcribed from the dashboard's 'Average Land Price per Square Meter by Existing Land Use (Transactions Data)' table. They are aggregate land-use indicators, not individual sale rows.
